recipe.visualDefinition: A symmetrical split-screen digital illustration featuring two identical portraits of a male figure with stylized, painterly textures. The left side represents a 'light' theme with white smoke, a skull, and yellow flowers, while the right side represents a 'dark' theme with black smoke, crows, and dark figures emerging from the head. The composition uses a high-contrast black and white background with vibrant yellow and pink floral accents.
coreVisualRelationships: Mirror-image symmetry between the two main portraits
Conceptual contrast between white smoke/skull and black smoke/crows
Integration of hand-drawn script with illustrative elements
Consistent painterly rendering across both halves to unify the duality
coreInvariants: Identical facial expression and angle for both portraits
Yellow and pink flower motifs appearing on both sides
Heavy black background at the bottom for text grounding

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two large, centered portraits occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eyes of the portraits serve as the primary focal point, leading upward to the thematic elements.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the faces, move upward through the smoke to the script titles, then drop to the venue information at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dense central imagery surrounded by atmospheric, brush-stroked white and black space.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black and White (background and thematic smoke)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm skin tones and gold jewelry
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white smoke on the left and black smoke on the right; saturated yellow accents pop against the monochrome base.

letterConstructionRules: Main titles use thick, fluid brush strokes with varying line weights
Script features connected letters with sharp, expressive terminals
Venue text uses uniform, wide-tracked geometric capitals
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'T' in the script titles features a long, horizontal crossbar that acts as a shelf for other elements
Ascenders and descenders are exaggerated for a gestural, hand-painted feel

composition.relationshipToImage: anchored in the black negative space

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Expressive, organic script for emotional titles paired with rigid, geometric sans-serif for functional information.

preserve: The contrast between white and black smoke
The wide tracking of the bottom text
avoid: Standard system fonts for the script titles

candidateDirections.reason: To match the raw, hand-painted energy of the illustration.
To provide a clean, modern contrast for the venue details.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a split-screen illustration. On the left, a man's portrait with white smoke, a skull, and yellow flowers emerging from his head against a white background. On the right, the same portrait with black smoke, crows, and dark figures emerging against a dark background. Use a painterly, textured style.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, white hand-lettered script titles in the upper center of each half. Add two lines of wide-tracked, all-caps geometric sans-serif text at the very bottom of each half, centered.

verificationChecks: Is the symmetry between the two portraits maintained?
Does the script look hand-painted rather than typed?
Is the venue text at the bottom clearly legible against the black background?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features to avoid likeness issues

mustAchieve: Seamless integration of illustration and text
Balanced weight between the two halves
avoid: Default brush settings that look digital

postGenerationChecks: Check for visual balance between the light and dark sides.
Ensure the script titles are the most prominent text element.
Verify that the painterly texture is consistent across both portraits.
Confirm the wide tracking on the bottom text is preserved.
recipe.reuseFormula: Split-screen duality + painterly portrait + thematic head-burst (light vs dark) + integrated brush script + geometric footer text.
